simple.summary: אָח (ʼâch) means a fire-pot or chafing dish First listed occurrence: Jer 36 22.

definitions.full: H254. ach II. אָח see II. אחח . II. אָח noun feminine fire-pot, brasier (Arabic in Thes, is an error) is loan-word from Egyptian &las— according to WMM OLZ 3, 51 ; Jer 36:22 read הָאָח וְאֵשׁ ; always with article 36:22 מְבֹעָ֑רֶת ׳הַא לְפָנָיו the brasier before him was burning ; 36:23 אֶלהָֿא אֲשֶׁר ׳הָאֵשׁ ; 36:23 עַלהָֿא אֲשֶׁר ׳הָאֵשׁ (I. אָח , brother see below אחה ; III. אָח interjection, p. 25).
